passingCriteria: Score of 60 or higher (automatic fail if any subject is below 40%)
difficulty: Beginner · Aimed at learners who are new to Linux
prerequisites: There are no eligibility requirements for either Part 1 or Part 2. Unlike Level 1, Part 2 does not require passing Part 1.

faq.q: How is the Linux Master Level 2 exam administered?
faq.a: It has two stages, Part 1 and Part 2. Part 1 is an online exam of 50 four-option multiple-choice questions in 60 minutes. Part 2 is a written exam taken at a test center, with 80 four-option questions in 100 minutes.
A score of 60 or higher passes, and scoring below 40% in any subject is an automatic fail. This standard applies to Part 1 and Part 2 separately.

faq.q: How much is the exam fee?
faq.a: Part 1 costs KRW 22,000 and Part 2 costs KRW 44,000. You register and pay for Part 1 and Part 2 separately.

faq.q: Do I have to pass Part 1 before taking Part 2?
faq.a: No. Level 2 has no eligibility requirements for either Part 1 or Part 2. Level 1 restricts Part 2 to Part 1 passers, but Level 2 does not.

There are three subjects: Linux Fundamentals, Linux Operation and Management, and Using Linux. Linux Fundamentals covers understanding Linux, installation, and basic commands; Operation and Management covers file system commands, the shell, process management, editors, software installation, and device configuration; and Using Linux covers the X Window system, internet usage, and application areas. The scoring weight for each subject is not published in the official notice.
